user_authorization: 기존 정책과 모델은 그대로 두고 기존 실측 자료로 하강·장시간 온도 예측 보완 및 상승·하강 정확도 개선 비교
registration: Before any new candidate fit or candidate heldout result
baseline: Frozen pipeline_thermal_v1 group-excluded predicted-power-driven thermal OOF, 208 sessions; preserve all previous models and gate FAIL
data: Exact same208 sessions and25975 AP observations; no eligibility promotion; same27 outer groups
architecture: Baseline temperature + ridge-trained signed causal stable-filter residual. Empirical response surrogate, not identified physical R/C.
allowed_inputs: known activity9 phase intervals supplied equally to baseline and candidates
predicted capacity power from existing outer-group-excluded power model
prohibited_inputs: post-anchor measured AP or future power as predictor features
hidden simulator progress or future actual arrivals
initialization: All correction states zero at anchor; filter states use causal activity only; bounded stable kernels; no temperature clip or invented throttling
residual: Can absorb power and thermal systematic error; coefficients are empirical and are not physical device constants

candidates.objective: Equal-session mean squared level residual + lambda*L2; diagnostic reference
Equal-session level MSE + equal-session late(t>=256s) level MSE + class-balanced10s delta MSE + lambda*L2; fixed primary candidate

ridge: lambda=1/39, fixed; train-only weighted RMS scaling with floor1e-6; no tuning or selection on outer results
derivative_training: Only TRAIN observed10s direction labels; same10s +/-0.2C windows; each class and within-class session equal weight
leakage_control: For each heldoutG, existing power modelG and existing thermal modelG excludeG. Recompute baseline and input features for ALL train/test sessions with these same outerG models. Never train correction on other OOF rows whose base models includedG.
original_metrics: Reuse exact baseline10s +/-0.2C measured labels/windows and session-macro MAE/direction; report OLD/M8/R21 and t>=256s, sensitivity thresholds unchanged
joint_goal: Primary candidate must lower overall/rise/fall/late MAE and not lower rise/fall direction to claim simultaneous improvement; otherwise report partial gain or failure, no gate promotion
reporting: Both candidates/all outer groups/failures visible. All data already reviewed; development OOF, not independent device confirmation. No candidate policy simulation or automatic adoption.
